maps.name: Forest forts
maps.design: Wooded outer banks frame two approach roads and a central clearing. One complete healing fort anchors the contested center.

maps.name: Woodland
maps.design: A broad river splits two wooded banks. Three two-tile bridge crossings offer a central push and two flanking routes; no healing forts obscure the two home castle objectives.

maps.name: Crossroads
maps.design: Lakes flank a broad central road junction. Woods cover the approaches while open side routes permit a bypass; no extra forts.

maps.name: Open field
maps.design: A wide open central meadow with paired edge ponds, a narrow central trail and clear flanking space. No healing forts.

maps.name: Twin groves
maps.design: Two large wooded flanks surround paired ponds. Parallel roads and a cross-map clearing let armies choose cover or speed; no extra forts.

maps.name: Central keep
maps.design: One central healing fort guards a causeway between lakes. Wooded approaches and narrow outer banks create alternate routes.

maps.name: Forest ring
maps.design: A ring of grouped woodland around twin ponds, split by a broad transverse clearing and two approach trails. No extra forts.

maps.name: Fort race
maps.design: A central lake system channels armies onto two side roads. Both race toward one healing fort on the middle causeway.
